pages.title: The Flint Age
pages.text: Your journey begins in the $(thing)Flint Age$(). With no metal tools available, you must rely on sharpened flint to survive.$(br2)Break gravel blocks to obtain $(item)Flint Shards$() — you'll need at least 4 to get started.$(br2)$(note)You may occasionally find a whole Flint piece from a single gravel block.$()

pages.title: First Tools
pages.text: Your first tool is the $(item)Flint Hatchet$() — it lets you fell trees to gather wood.$(br2)Next, craft a $(item)Flint Knife$() for basic combat, also an essential ingredient for crafting your first workbench.$(br2)Finally, combine a Flint Knife with any log to create the $(item)Flint Crafting Table$().
$(item)Flint Knife$() — needed for the crafting table.
$(item)Flint Crafting Table$() — the gateway to everything.

pages.title: Your Next Goal: Copper
pages.text: With your Flint Crafting Table ready, your next objective is $(item)Copper$().$(br2)Collect $(thing)27 Copper Nuggets$() to craft a $(item)Copper Pickaxe$() — this will $(important)unlock village spawning$().$(br2)Perhaps there are other ways to bypass this node? (a hidden advancement)

pages.title: Next Steps
pages.text: Once you have copper tools, learn about the tier system.
